user.title: Connect to PlusPortal
user.description: Your tenant number is the six-digit code at the start of your portal address, for example 123456.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-enter your password
reauth_confirm.description: The portal no longer accepts the stored password for {username}.

error.cannot_connect: The portal could not be reached.
error.invalid_tenant: Not a tenant number (e.g. 123456) or portal address.
error.no_meters: This account has no metering points, so there would be nothing to show.

abort.already_configured: This account is already set up.

init.title: Tariff and polling
init.description: The portal provides no price data, so enter your tariff here to get cost and settlement figures. Leave the prices empty to track consumption only.

error.invalid_billing_year_start: Enter the billing year start as MM-DD, e.g. 01-01. It must exist in every year, so 02-29 is not allowed.
